source.postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg12+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, PlanetScale Postgres, us-east-1
source.measured_by: benchmarks/tin_behavior_probe.py at 29a520e (the depth cases by the equivalent ad-hoc probe the same day)
source.notes: Responses of TIN, not of Stannum. Re-measure against a new TIN release into a new file named tin-<version>.json; never edit these values.

spans.note: ids: matches of body ==> query, identical with tin.enable_custom_scan on and off; ranked: ids of ORDER BY tin.full_score(ctid) DESC LIMIT 10

bm25_parameters.documents: id 1: 'w w w'; ids 2 to 10: 'w'; one index built after the inserts
bm25_parameters.note: float4_bits: float4send(tin.full_score(ctid, k1, 0.75)) per id; exhaustive_top: best (score desc, id asc) over every match; pruned_top_limit_1: id of ORDER BY tin.full_score(ctid, k1, 0.75) DESC LIMIT 1 through TIN's top-k scan

query_size.table: the spans documents; the term 'a' matches none of them
query_size.note: words: 'a ' repeated; or_chain: 'a OR a OR ...'; nested: '(' * depth + 'a' + ')' * depth. crashed_server: the connection dropped with no error, an idle second connection dropped too and statistics were reset (PostgreSQL reinitialized after a backend crash). Stannum must accept every accepted case with the same count and answer every crashed case with an ERROR or a correct count, never a crash.
